An artifact documenting the rules has to be able to quote them

Prose naming the banned classes: a span with class="ok" or class="badge" is a status pill, and a div with class="mermaid" is a Mermaid render. Neither of those phrases styles anything.

<span class="ok">done</span>
<div class="mermaid">graph TD; A-->B;</div>
<div id="mermaid-1"></div>
